hero.kheelu: Hi, I'm Kheelu. Come see what we're making.
hero.h1b: Made by people you can trust.
hero.sub: Screen-free friends that talk with your child and grow with them. We do not sell your family's data.

building.body: A gadget waits to be told what to do. A companion starts the conversation. Lumi asks your child a question, listens to the answer, then asks the next one. That back and forth is how your child learns to think.
building.support: Lumi listens and answers. It remembers what your child said last time. Your child feels known, not managed.

trust.h2: The part that matters most to you.

points.b: Your child's voice and words are never sold, and never used to sell them anything. That is a promise, not a setting you have to go find.
The first thinking happens on Lumi itself, before anything is sent anywhere.
Read every conversation. Delete anything in one tap. Choose the topics. The grown-up decides, always.
Lumi answers from a library you can see, not the open web. It wakes to a word, and the mic is off the rest of the time.

companions.h2: Meet the family. Lumi comes first.
companions.body: The same friend lives inside each one. Lumi is the first your child will meet. Lori, Lua, and Robu are on the way.
companions.range: Made for a three-year-old. Still a friend at ten.

warm.kheelu: That was the careful part. Now let me show you the fun.
warm.h2: Here is what a day with Lumi feels like.

feelings.body: Lumi knows five feelings. Feeling comes first, and the learning follows.

cards.name: Curious
cards.b: Asks why. Chases ideas. Wants to know what is around the corner.

cards.name: Grumpy
cards.b: Names the hard feeling instead of hiding it.

cards.name: Sad

cards.name: Silly
cards.b: Turns a dull afternoon into a game.

cards.name: Joy
cards.b: Celebrates the small wins out loud.

feelings.languages: Lumi talks in the languages you speak at home. Up to ten of them.

turns.t: Lumi, why is the moon following us?
It looks that way, doesn't it? The moon is very far away. Where are you off to?
Then the moon gets to meet her too.

upclose.h2: Most toys forget your child by morning. Lumi remembers.
upclose.modes: Three ways to be there. A friend when your child wants one. A storyteller at bedtime. A teacher when a why turns into a lesson. Lumi reads the moment and picks.
upclose.link: See how Lumi keeps your child safe

parents.h2: Your child is just playing. You can see the learning.
parents.body: Open the app for a daily summary, the full conversation log, and simple controls. Choose the character and the age setting. Manage what is downloaded. Updates arrive on their own.

pilot.h2: The first families are already talking.

quotes.q: My daughter says goodnight to Lumi before she says it to me. I have read every word they say. It is kind.
quotes.by: Ananya R., mother of two, Bengaluru

quotes.q: No screen, and he still asks for it first thing. That never happens.
She switched to Kannada and Lumi kept up. My mother was in tears.

playos.body: Lumi runs on PlayOS. It gives every character its own voice and personality, and answers that fit your child's age. It knows when to be a friend, a storyteller, or a teacher.

feelings.h2: Five feelings your child learns to name.
feelings.body: The learning starts with the heart. Name the feeling first, and the thinking follows.

library.h2: New things to do, long after launch.
library.body: You choose what Lumi carries. Stories, songs, lessons, and activity packs download to the device, so your child plays with them offline and screen-free. New packs and seasonal sets arrive over time. School learning modules are on the way.

parents.h2: You see every conversation. You decide what Lumi does next.
parents.body: A daily summary of what your child talked about. The full conversation log, kept private to you. Topic controls. Pick the character and the age setting. Manage downloads. Firmware and content update on their own.

faq.q: Is Lumi safe for my child?
faq.a: Lumi wakes to a word, thinks on the device first, and answers from a closed library. There is a safety check on every reply, and you can read or delete anything.
No. Lumi plays offline. You connect only to download new content or updates, and you decide when.
The languages you speak at home. Up to ten of them, and Lumi can switch mid-sentence.
Ages 3 to 10. Lumi meets younger children where they are and grows up with them.
